declaration.question: Can finite repeated service escape the one-contact Q/R compression without changing prices or selecting a duration?
declaration.design: Chess virtual8x8, one native current piece, two stationary capturable ordinary targets uniformly placed on unordered distinct non-source squares. No anchors, opponent actions, rights,EP,promotion or game labels. Count maximum actual target removals over two own movement actions, recomputing clear rays after first capture; quiet actions count toward horizon. Run Q/R/B/N as a partial mechanism diagnostic, no complete price candidate or WDL claim.
declaration.comparison: H1 and H2 means on same complete population; all four modes and all outcomes retained. Count direct geometric capture actions and quiet/capture child queries, not Core transitions. Target occupancy blocks rays until captured; leap can jump. No gamma fitting or human-label selection.
declaration.decision: If Q/R increases beyond one-hit bound, repeated service is a concrete construction lead; if not, retain negative mechanism evidence rather than tune horizon/weights. H2 vsH1 is a virtual opportunity diagnostic, not owned-resource lifetime because targets do not move/capture.
declaration.cost: 4*124992 root configurations; finite board ray/leap geometry caches, sequential script, expected seconds to minutes. Interruptible each source, no new worker or external engine.
